# TypeLua

> TypeLua is a typed superset of Lua (TypeScript-for-Lua). Types erase to idiomatic Lua (5.4 default, 5.1/LuaJIT compatible). Only `class`/`enum` emit runtime values.

- [Docs home](https://github.com/types-lua/docs): bilingual guides (EN/ZH) + full references
- [SPEC v0.8](https://github.com/types-lua/TypeLua/blob/main/SPEC.md): normative language contract, §§1–16
- [Examples](https://github.com/types-lua/TypeLua/tree/main/examples): 25 runnable `tlua check`-clean programs
- [Diagnostics](https://github.com/types-lua/TypeLua/blob/main/internal/diag/codes.go): stable `TLxxxx` registry
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/types-lua/TypeLua/blob/main/AGENTS.md): agent bootstrap for the compiler repo

## Guide (site: https://types-lua.github.io/docs/)

- [Index](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/): what/why, doc map
- [Quickstart](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/01-quickstart): init/check/build/run in 5 minutes
- [Language](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/02-language): types, declarations, narrowing, classes, generics
- [CLI & Tooling](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/03-cli): tlua.json, `--format=json`, packages, LSP
- [Concurrency](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/04-concurrency): defer, coroutines, async/spawn/chan/select
- [FFI & Native](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/05-ffi): ffi, bindgen, shims, .d.tl, assets
- [Patterns & Fixes](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/06-patterns): recipes + TL error-fix table
- [Testing](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/07-testing): `tlua test`, assertions, CI recipe
- [Examples](https://types-lua.github.io/docs/en/08-examples): `tlua example`, cargo-style runs

## Quickstart

```bash
go build -o tlua ./cmd/tlua
./tlua init
./tlua check --format=json
./tlua build
./tlua run --check main.tl
```

```lua
type Point = { x: number, y: number }
local function dist(a: Point, b: Point): number
  local dx: number = a.x - b.x
  local dy: number = a.y - b.y
  return dx * dx + dy * dy
end
local p: Point = { x = 1, y = 2 }
print(dist(p, { x = 4, y = 6 }))
```

## Testing (zero config)

```
tlua test
tlua test --filter NAME --format=json
tlua test --lua luajit --target 5.1
```

A test file returns named cases and imports the injected helper:

```lua
import T from "tlua_test"
return {
  ["adds"] = function(): void T.eq(1 + 1, 2) end,
}
```

## Examples (cargo style)

```
tlua example              # list examples/*.tl and examples/*/main.tl
tlua example basic -- a   # run with arguments
```

The first `---` line of an example is its description.

## Rules

- Valid Lua 5.4 is valid TypeLua; `type`/`class`/`import`/`defer`/`await`/`spawn`/`select`/`async`/`macro` are contextual.
- `strictNilChecks` is on: narrow with `==nil`/`~=nil`, `type(x)==`, `=="lit"`, truthiness, member paths.
- `interface` is structural, `class` instances are nominal; `super(...)` only in derived constructors before `self`.
- `import N from "p"` is typed `require` sugar; `require("ffi")` is typed only when `require` is not shadowed.
- `defer f()` takes a call, LIFO at function exit; `errdefer` only on explicit `error()` in the same function.
- Concurrency is single-threaded CSP: `await`/`select` outside `async` is `TL3801`/`TL3802`; sync callers cannot call blocking primitives (`TL3805`).
- FFI/`.so` needs `--target 5.1` + `--lua luajit`; `ffi.cdef` is opaque, hand-write `as CLib`; `.d.tl` checks but never emits.
- JSON diags: `{file,line,column,endLine,endColumn,severity,code,category,message}`; `code` is stable.

## tlua.json

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": { "target": "5.4", "strict": true, "outDir": "dist", "rootDir": "." },
  "include": ["**/*.tl"],
  "exclude": ["dist"]
}
```

Full reference: `https://types-lua.github.io/docs/llms-full.txt`. Chinese: `https://types-lua.github.io/docs/llms-zh.txt` (concise), `https://types-lua.github.io/docs/llms-full-zh.txt` (full).
